description: Enhanced boundary coverage for LINE reads (native-disjoint). Exercises partial-coordinate population (only P2 supplied so P1 falls back to the origin), negative and integer-formatted coordinates (the library renders reals with the round-trip 'R' format so whole numbers carry no decimal point), a large-magnitude coordinate with thickness-only, and a non-default extrusion direction supplied on its own.
